summary: Phase 4B complete (plan v14): all FOUR engine-quantifying lemmas ported to the B-engine in one dispatch — the pre-authorized 4B.1/4B.2 split was NOT needed. Ports (all in Scheme.lean, new 'B-Engine Ports' section, pure insertions): intExpandBranchesB_openBranch_closed (probe, sorry-free), intExpandBranchesB_closed_unsat (~660-line port of the Soundness.lean lemma; sorry-free; lean_verify {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}; landed in Scheme.lean because the import direction Expansion→Soundness→Scheme makes the B-engine invisible from Soundness.lean — enabled by de-privatizing 11 Soundness.lean helper lemmas, visibility-only edit), intExpandBranchesB_openBranch_initial_mem (sorry-free), intExpandBranchesB_openBranch_sat (succ-case content; NO R1 hypotheses yet — Phase 6). Fuel-0 carry realized by CONSUMPTION: the B-engine's exhaustion arm is discharged by invoking the OLD sorried lemma at fuel := 0 on the singleton [bPers] (its findSome? arm returns .openBranch bPers), so the pre-existing sorry flows via sorryAx with ZERO new bare-sorry tokens — census stays exactly 4, satisfying both the phase gate and the plan's carried-1-for-1 note. Primary proof route validated: functional induction intExpandBranchesB.go.induct (10 cases); no fallback needed. Both big ports gain a fuels.length = branches.length hypothesis (needed for the engine's list-mismatch arm; call sites supply it trivially). Old engine + old lemmas + all Preserved-Assets rows untouched and green. CI: full lake build green (3311 jobs); checkInitImports 0; lake lint 0; lint-style 0; shake 0; lake test 0 (corpus untouched).
